annotations.title: List every module's packet coverage for an extraction job

description: For each extraction module (pinout, absolute_max, thermal, logic_levels, power_battery, timing, part_decoder, register_map, peripheral_matrix, analog_intelligence, passive_bom, pin_cautions), what its packet holds of the job's parsed datasheet: status (routed, routed_partial, nothing_routed: a statement about routing, never about the part), the target package it is scoped to, notes (what the packet does not do yet, e.g. target_package_unknown, other_package_blocks_removed), pages, blocks, chars and token_estimate. Also depth_recommendation: which depth this document's parse points to (fast or full_audit, null without a readable parse) with reasons in plain words and the facts behind them; a recommendation, never a promise of accuracy. No block bodies: read one module's blocks with datasheetvend_get_module_packet. Deterministic: reads the job's stored parse (parsed_document_v1), calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API. Refusals: NOT_PARSED / PARSE_FAILED (no usable parse stored for this job), PARSE_EXPIRED (past retention), DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE (over 20,000 blocks). Every block, cell and word comes with its page, box ([x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points, origin top-left), quoted text and parse {document_sha256, parser_version, block_id, cell_id}; block ids are stable only within one parser_version.
